title: Bugsy
tagline: He dreamed up Las Vegas. Then he blew the budget.
about: A charismatic gangster builds a lavish casino hotel in the Nevada desert.
cue: Serve dessert when Ben first stands in the empty desert and pictures his casino.
faces: Our namesake, hung in the lobby. Long legs, all pink,
and about as native to the desert as we are.
They said nobody would drive out to the middle of nowhere for a steak. Look around. Order anything. The house can take it.
P.S. It’s Ben. Never the other name.
The site, last spring. Sand, sky and one good idea.
The boss’s diction drill: “Six slick ships sail south.”
SUPPER IN THE SHOWROOM · MENU INSIDE
Downtown, 1940: boots and sawdust. Out here, black tie.
Warm buckwheat cakes, crème fraîche, red salmon caviar, snipped chives.
Chicken, bacon, avocado, egg, tomato, blue cheese, in lettuce cups.
Miss Hill’s way: gin, fresh lime and soda, shell left in.
Sugar cube, bitters, a lemon twist.
Rib eye pounded thin, seared hot, flamed in brandy, then shallot, Dijon, Worcestershire and cream.
Carved to order, natural juices, popover.
Crisp meringue, soft middle, whipped cream and crushed raspberries.
Prices subject to change. Valet by Mr. Cohen’s boys. Mr. Raft’s table held.
Form 46-B. Highway 91, the middle of nowhere, Nevada. 1946.

    StartersCaviar bliniWarm buckwheat cakes, crème fraîche, red salmon caviar, snipped chives.From eight, in the lounge.How to make it16 buckwheat blinis4 tsp crème fraîche3 tbsp salmon roe1 tbsp snipped chivesWarm the blini at 180°C for 5 minutes.Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives.Serve straight away on a tray.Cobb cupsChicken, bacon, avocado, egg, tomato, blue cheese, in lettuce cups.Mr. Raft's table is always held.How to make it400g chicken breast (2)4 rashers of bacon2 eggs1 avocado2 tomatoes12 little gem lettuce leaves60g blue cheese, crumbled4 tbsp red wine vinaigrettePoach the chicken for 12 minutes, cool and dice.Fry the bacon until crisp and crumble. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and chop.Dice the avocado and tomatoes.Fill the lettuce leaves with everything, scatter over the blue cheese and spoon over the vinaigrette.MainsSteak DianeRib eye pounded thin, seared hot, flamed in brandy, then shallot, Dijon, Worcestershire and cream.Served at nine. The house can take it.How to make it800g scotch fillet steaks (4)30g butter2 shallots, chopped1 garlic clove, crushed60ml brandy1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce150ml beef stock150ml creamFlatten the steaks and sear hot for 2 minutes a side, then rest.In the same pan soften the shallots and garlic in the butter, add the brandy and flame.Stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, stock and cream and reduce.Return the steaks to coat in the sauce.SweetsPavlovaCrisp meringue, soft middle, whipped cream and crushed raspberries.Pink, for the bird in the lobby.How to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour1 tsp white vinegar300ml thickened cream125g raspberries, crushedWhisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Fold in the cornflour and vinegar and spread into a round.Bake at 120°C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven.Whip the cream and fold through the raspberries. Pile on top just before serving.DrinksGin rickeyMiss Hill's way: gin, fresh lime and soda, shell left in.Poured in the lounge.How to make it180ml gin2 limes600ml soda water1 bag iceFill four highball glasses with ice.Add gin and the juice of half a lime to each and drop in the squeezed shell.Top with soda water.
